additions.name: Sharjah Museum of Islamic Civilization
additions.location: Al Mujarrah - Hay Al Sharq - Al Nabba - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
additions.notes: Insightful museum that tells a lot of things about the history of Islam and its impact in the West Asia and the world. The museum is full of actual demos of earliest water clocks, mathematical instruments, etc. that I particularly loved.

additions.name: Rain Room
additions.location: 26 St - Al Majarra - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
additions.notes: This is an art installation. Wherever you stand, it doesn't rain and everywhere else it rains. Picturesque and calming.

additions.name: House of Wisdom
additions.location: 8G94+9C8 - Al Juraina 1 - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
additions.notes: This is the epitome of a public library. It has a huge collection of books, lots of places to sit and discuss (indoors and outdoors). The restaurant/cafe inside is also top notch, though slightly expensive.

additions.name: Madurai Biriyani Restaurant
additions.location: Al Ahmed Building - near Muwailah Park - Muwaileh Commercial - Industrial Area - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
additions.notes: This place has one of the best "South Indian" biryanis I have ever had. Try their mutton nalli (goat bone marrow) biryani which is even better than I had in Chennai. Service is also top notch. 10/10 recommended.

additions.name: Alserkal Avenue
additions.location: 17th St - Al Qouz Ind.first - Al Quoz - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
additions.notes: This is a great arts district where you can walk around to find some good, artful museums and stores. There are minimalistic pieces and contemporary arabic art — all kinds.

additions.name: Julith Coffee & Roastery
additions.location: 1 ,Kunooz - Warehouse 1 6th St - Al Qouz Ind.first - Al Quoz - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
additions.notes: This is top notch coffee place in Dubai. They roast their own beans and they're really fresh. Also, a good place to buy beans if you would like.

additions.name: Wokyo Noodle Bar - Al Seef
additions.location: Heritage Village - AlHamriya, Souk - P3 - Shop 381 Al Seef St - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
additions.notes: What a delicious ramen place! You can sit cross-legged on a table enjoying authentic ramen in the beautiful Al Seef corniche area. I would recommend walking around the corniche to create appetite and then walking around again after delicious (and heavy) meal.

additions.name: The Miners Coffee Naschmarkt
additions.notes: Nice cafe to sit and work at. Delicious cortado and helpful staff. Will recommend!

additions.name: Café Landtmann
additions.notes: This is a historic cafe and restaurant with delicious baked items and good melange. Would recommend for a place close to the University of Wien.
